M74 tiny FBX / GLB format fixture

Original procedural geometry and skeletal performance created for Project Judas
by the accompanying make_fbx_fixture.py with Blender 5.2.1. No downloaded models,
commercial animation, ignored asset library, or captured performance is used.

The fixture contains five authored bones, different local bone rolls, a helper
between Base and Reach, asymmetric reach rotation, translated Base locomotion,
and a separate helper bob. All mesh vertices have one explicit bone weight.

Blender is only the source-art generator/exporter. The production Judas importer,
profile validator, retarget math and cooker perform all animation transfer.

Geometry, skeleton, generated FBX/GLB and this generator are dedicated to the
public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal. No attribution is required.
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Regeneration:
/home/conner/Programs/blender-5.2.1-linux-x64/blender --background --factory-startup --python tests/fixtures/m74/make_fbx_fixture.py

Source import units: Blender metres, FBX encoded unit metadata, normalized by the
ordinary M66 ufbx entry point. GLB uses its ordinary metre/Y-up normalization.
